newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kawasaki says Malaysia decides against steel plan.
newsitem.headline: Kawasaki says Malaysia decides against steel plan.

text.p: Kawasaki Steel Corp said on Friday that the Malaysian government had decided not to proceed with a planned steel plant project.

In July last year, Kawasaki said it had agreed with the Malaysian government to conduct a feasibility study into steel sheet production in Malaysia with an annual output capacity of three million tonnes.

But Kawasaki said that as a result of the nine-month study, the government decided not to proceed with the project at this time because of an anticipated low profit margin and because of the huge resources the project would require.
